name: Young Dragons Summer STEAM
description_short: Free week long STEAM camps from Drexel's ExCITe Center for rising 6th to 8th graders who live or go to school in West Philadelphia. Each week covers a different science, technology, engineering, arts or math topic through hands on projects. Families apply online.
notes: Free. Open only to rising 6th to 8th graders who live or attend school in West Philadelphia (the program began with the West Philadelphia Promise Zone). The page posts the 2026 application but no session dates, hours or camp location; the ZIP is from the Drexel University address in the page footer, not a stated camp site.
